description.en: Multi-member version of AddParty_Message: adds several party members in sequence, each with the standard "J_08" jingle and "sysmes-add_party" message presentation and a BGM fade — a fixed-preset wrapper around AddParty_MessageEx.
Array of param IDs, one per member to add.
Array of position-lock flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-enable flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-lock flags, one per member.
Array of levels to set, one per member (-1 to leave unchanged).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Add three party members in sequence with the standard recruitment presentation
AddPartyNum_Message(3, charaID, ptLock, avaEnable, avaLock, level);
